levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
أحمد بن الحسن بن علي بن فضال

notes: the compiler's father is named only as «أبي»: a bare relation, read as the first link; four co-transmitters meet at عبد الله بن بكير (no «ح» here)
the Imam after «عن» stays a narrator (rule 2 of the Imami rulings); the saying after «قال» is his words, and the blessing is not part of the surface
